gate: Inventory identity, lots, condition, traceability established
pass_condition: Count by lot, weight, condition, invoice traceability, no unresolved damage
if_failed: Hold stock; reconcile before sampling or sale

gate: Product classification and applicable Amazon path understood
pass_condition: Written determination: conventional food vs dietary supplement vs unresolved, and the Amazon compliance path that follows
if_failed: Use most restrictive path; do not choose a category to avoid requirements

gate: Selected testing and sampling approach confirmed
pass_condition: Lab identity, panel, methods, sample plan, multi-lot handling and turnaround definition confirmed
if_failed: Do not ship samples until confirmed; clock cannot start

pass_condition: Report reviewed by a qualified reviewer against applicable requirements; gaps identified
if_failed: Hold affected inventory; define investigation/retest path

pass_condition: Defensible basis for remaining shelf life and the date marking to be printed
evidence_required: Supplier stability evidence + lab basis + manufacture date
if_failed: Launch blocker; do not invent or reset an expiry date

gate: Labeling, organic claims and applicable verification complete
pass_condition: Label-gap review closed; organic claim supported by certificate; Amazon-required verification completed where applicable
evidence_required: Approved label + certificate scope + verification records
if_failed: Remove unsupported claims; do not dispatch

gate: Pilot unit and carton inspection passed
pass_condition: Sample unit meets spec, seal and label correct, cartons correct
if_failed: Quarantine; re-pack only under qualified supervision

pass_condition: All prior gates met; quarantine respected; not all units necessarily shipped
ASIN live with active offer and in-stock inventory
